description: This file defines the class 'soap_server', which implements a SOAP server framework for handling SOAP requests and responses, including WSDL integration, method registration, request parsing, and response serialization.

classes.name: soap_server
classes.description: A class that implements a SOAP server capable of handling SOAP messages, registering methods, generating WSDL, parsing incoming requests, and sending responses.

methods.name: service
methods.description: Processes a SOAP request, returning the appropriate response or WSDL.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a PHP function, class method, or class..method with the SOAP server for remote invocation.

methods.name: fault
methods.description: Sets up a SOAP fault to signal an error condition to the client.

methods.name: configureWSDL
methods.description: Configures and initializes the WSDL for the SOAP service, allowing for internal WSDL generation.
